articleTitle: Analysis and Comparison of the Spring Framework and Play Framework Performance, Used to Create Web Applications in Java
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In the era of continuous technological development, which is followed by the increase in the speed of computers and the Internet, it is also important to develop techniques and programming languages as well as various mechanisms helping programmers in their work. Therefore, the frameworks were created, or skeleton applications that define the application structure and the general mechanism of its operation, to facilitate writing programs and unify the structure of various applications. The purpose of this article is to analyze and compare the performance of two popular frameworks, used to create a server part of a web application in Java, namely the Spring Framework and Play Framework.

articleTitle: Composite Material Microlevel Cellular Model Data Transfer and Verification by FEM Analysis Software Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Solution for composite materials microlevel cellular structural model data transfer between different finite element analysis software tools is presented that makes a practical value. Verification of heat conduction problem inside such models by distributed computing engine, ANSYS software, and COMSOL system is described.

articleTitle: Optimization of Biological Wastewater Treatment Process by Hierarchical Adaptive Control
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Article presents the models for optimization of biological wastewater treatment process by hierarchical adaptive control approach inside embedded system of communal wastewater treatment plant.

articleTitle: Research of Alternating Current Single-Phase Collector Motor Models Developed on the Basis of Project Design Data
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The model of an alternating current single-phase collector motor in the MATLAB Simulink environment has been developed and researched on the basis of the data obtained through project design calculation, during which all the motor parameters required for the mathematical model have been obtained. It has offered considerable opportunities for applying this approach in further research of this motor type. The model of such motor has been also developed and investigated on the basis of an existing universal motor model in the library of MATLAB Simulink and the data obtained from project design calculation. A comparative analysis of the results obtained on both models has allowed for the conclusion about high degree of their coincidence and the possibility of their application for further studies.

articleTitle: Development of Intelligent Point Multi-Sensor Fire Detector with Fuzzy Correction Block
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The intelligent point multi-sensor fire detector with smoke and heat sensors has been proposed using a fuzzy correction block synthesized on the basis of fuzzy logic theory. The algorithm of the work of this block has been developed: the forms and parameters of the input and output membership functions have been established; based on expert knowledge, a base of fuzzy rules that describe the state of the environment in the room has been compiled. According to the developed algorithm of work, the fuzzy correction block recognizes the change in temperature and smoke concentration in the room and generates the required output signal. This allows you to detect a fire at the early stage. The work of this fire detector has been investigated on the developed digital model of the fuzzy correction block.

articleTitle: Modeling and Calculation of the Temperature-Force Regime of Functioning of an Electrically Conductive Cylindrical Sensor under the Pulsed Electromagnetic Action in the Mode of the Damped Sinusoid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The temperature-force regime of functioning of a cylindrical electrically conductive sensor under the action of the pulsed electromagnetic force in the mode of the damped sinusoid is investigated.

articleTitle: Schematic Realization of Flexible Algorithm in Treatment Diagnostic Devices
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: A structural and functional block diagram of treatment diagnostic devices on a flexible algorithm has been developed. An algorithm of the system of continuous monitoring as the basis for implementing the new class of devices feature automatic continuous evaluation of effectiveness treatments has been proposed.

articleTitle: Development of the Method Local Navigation of Mobile Robot a Based on the Tags with QR Code and Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This paper describes the improved method for locating a mobile platform. Base stations and a navigation system based on QR code tags is used along with an odometric positioning system using the tachometers. The principle of the program for controlling the movement of the robotic platform in the automated warehouse is described. The algorithm of determine the robot coordinates by the image of QR code tags is offered. Images come sequentially while moving during by means of a video camera, rigidly fixed at robot, is offered. The results of experiments for mobile robot, which confirm the effectiveness of the proposed approach, are presented also.

articleTitle: Optimization of Probe Parameters of Atomic Force Microscope Cantilever
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this work an analysis of two-criterion Pareto optimization of cantilever-type power sensors vibration is performed. Two-criteria Pareto front in deviation-frequency coordinates satisfies the condition of point's uniform distribution.

articleTitle: Simulation, Making and Testing of the Actuator of Precise Positioning Based on the Bimorph Plate of Lithium Niobate
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The simulation of the actuator based on lithium niobate bidomain structure was carried out. The dependencies of the values of actuator displacements on its geometrical dimensions and the applied voltages were determined. Particularly, it is shown that the dependence of the displacement on the applied voltage is linear in the whole investigated range (-300... 300V). Based on the simulation results, an actuator was manufactured from the oppositely polarized plates of congruent lithium niobate connected by diffusion of copper from the film placed between the plates. It was found that the displacement of this actuator is equal to 9 nm upon the applied voltage of 1 V, and to 26.5 nm upon 3 V.

articleTitle: A* Modification for Mobile Robotic Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In the work, a software based on the MVC methodology is developed using the LIDAR and SLAM technology, which allows automatic control of the mobile robot in real-time. An algorithm is developed which builds a graph based on data obtained from a mobile robot based on polar coordinates of points. To implement the search of the route on the graph, the A * algorithm was improved for use in robotized systems.

articleTitle: Influence of Fringing Field on Estimating of Comb-Drive Accelerometer Performance
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper we present the influence of omitting the fringing field in calculations on estimating of comb-drive accelerometer performance. Such sensor consist of many parallel plate capacitors that forms combs wherein electric field occurs also outside the overlapping area of fingers. Therefore, the real capacitance is larger than it results from the basic equation for parallel plate capacitor. Thus, the knowledge about the amount of underestimation is crucial when estimating the device performance. Three structures are analyzed: parallel plate capacitor, comb-drive structure and whole comb-drive accelerometer. The simulations include the influence of gap distance, the size of surrounding environment and the difference between calculated and real capacitance. In comparison analytical model and Comsol is used.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Accuracy of Barometric Pressure Sensors to Assessment of Their Possibility for UAVs Landing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This paper describes the results of the simulation of an absolute pressure sensor, which is used as a flight altitude meter, provided that its readings are corrected based on measured values of air humidity and ambient temperature. The simulation is performed using a virtual project of an altimeter created in the LabVIEW program, to which the test set of the specified sensors is connected.

articleTitle: Temperature Sensors Based on Metal-Silicon Microstructure for Microsystem Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The basis of the research of this work is to predict the characteristics of sensors of the thermal quantities based on silicon whiskers admixture with B & Ni impurities. In these samples, the concentration of the transport impurity of boron corresponds to the phase transition of the metal-insulator in silicon from the metallic side. On the basis of experimental temperature dependences of resistance of microcrystals Si (B, Ni) with a concentration of boron NB≈l×1019 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> and resistivity crystals P300k=0.007 Ohmxcm in the temperature range 4,2-300 K, the linear dependence of the resistance versus temperature with positive values of the temperature resistance coefficient is shown. Determined by the temperature of liquefied helium maximum magnetoresistance reaches no more than 4% in magnetic fields with induction do14T. Proposed thermoresistive sensor is working in harsh operating environment and is resistant to the influence of destabilizing factors.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of Equivalent Stress Value Dependence from Displacement of RF MEMS Membrane
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In the paper, a mathematical model of equivalent stress value dependence from displacement of RF MEMS membrane is developed. For this the influence of displacement of RF MEMS membrane on equivalent stress value is simulated. According to the simulation results, a mathematical model describing this parameters dependence is developed. The assessment of model is presented.

articleTitle: Efficiency Evaluation of Photovoltaic Power Converters for Ultra-Low Power Supply Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Power-over-Fiber (PoF) is a very promising technique and recent technology development makes it applicable. However the cost of PoF is high since high powered laser, photovoltaic power converters and special optical fibers are used. In this paper the detailed efficiency evaluation of optical power supply system based on standard, low cost telecom components are given. Different semiconductor materials were characterized to build the most efficient supply system. The highest conversion efficiency of photodiode equal to 26.2% and the efficiency of whole system equal to 13% is achieved.

articleTitle: The Creativity of the Application of MEMS in the Implementation of Technical Activities as a Result of Engineering Education in the Field of Environmental Protection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Stages of engineering education and selected application of Micro Electro-Mechanical Systems (MEMS) as an example of the creativity of using MEMS in the implementation of technical activities and as a result of engineering education in the field of environmental protection are presented in the publication. The development of technical education and engineering education at technical studies are presented. Engineering studies in Poland and an example of education in technical fields was presented. A creative example of the use of MEMS in the implementation of a mobile air purification station was pointed out. On the basis of registered information about air pollution in the device surroundings and analyzes of the work of the air purification station, information on the effectiveness of the air filtration process was obtained.

articleTitle: The Development of Information Technology and the Selected Application of MEMS as an Example of Integration of Information System in the Area of Ecology Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This work presents the development of information technology and the selected application of Micro Electro-Mechanical Systems (MEMS) as an example of integration of information system applications in the area of ecology. The development of information systems is presented, which is shown as subjecting it to a number of transformation methods and procedures. The development of information technology over the last century has been shown. It showed how common MEMS technology has become as an effect of the development of information systems. One of the potential applications of MEMS in an ecological context has been presented. An example of using this technology is a weather station. The information obtained from it is particularly important in the case of heavily polluted environments.

articleTitle: Investigation of Thermoelectric Generators for Alternative Power Supply Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Thermoelectric generators (TEG) are investigated as energy source for ultra-low power electronics. The best TEG provides Pout = 50 mW and Vout = 650 mV which is sufficient to power supply the modern electronics circuits.

articleTitle: Preliminary Investigation of Temporomandibular Joint Acoustic Effects
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper we describe a preliminary study on recording and digital signal processing of temporomandibular joint (TMJ) acoustic signal. Disorders of TMJ can be analysed based on auscultation examination which can be supported by dedicated processing algorithms. In our research we proposed a method for determining the best placement of the stethoscope head for TMJ auscultation and an algorithm for automatic sound segmentation. The research was carried out in cooperation with dentist support and proved that designed methods have a great potential in dental clinical applications.

articleTitle: 52 DVA for the MEMS Devices
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper, an efficient numerical approach based on the theoretical-experimental method is proposed to maximize the minimal damping of modes in a prescribed frequency range by means of dynamic vibration absorbers (DVA) for the MEMS devices. The influence of the different types of DVA and basic design elastic and damping properties is under discussion. A technique is developed to give the optimal DVA's for the elimination of excessive vibration in sinusoidal forced MEMS devices. Different types of control management for semi-active DVA's are applied. Examples of DVA's practical implementation are presented.

articleTitle: Developing a Local Positioning Algorithm Based on the Identification of Objects in a Wi-Fi Network of the Mall
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The proposed algorithm for local positioning in the mall is based on the Wi-Fi standard, in which the signal strength received by the mobile device from Wi-Fi access points is the only source of information about the location of objects. The study formalizes the problem of local identification of the object in the mall using Wi-Fi technology; The requirements for a local positioning system that identifies an object using Wi-Fi technology are formulated. The developed prototype can be used to determine the location and construction of a route of a moving object in the mall.

articleTitle: Microfluidic Lab-Chip Device Dedicated for Colorimetric Detection of Hazardous Impurities in Water Samples
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This research presents Lab-Chip design for colorimetric detection of acidic and nitrate impurities in water/rainwater samples. Photocolorimetric method is analyzed and used for Lab-Chip point-of-care applications. Pressure, flow rate and reagents concentration distribution over microchannel system are simulated in COMSOL.

articleTitle: Mathematical Simulation of Electric Voltage in Lossy Transmission Line and the Problems of Optimizing MEMS - Devices Parameters
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Boundary value problems for hyperbolic equation are used to model the various types of oscillations of structures or wave propagation in media. Such problems, in general, are ill-posed due to presence of resonance phenomena in the investigated models. In this paper, an exact solution for non-local problem with integral term for telegraph equation in bounded domain is constructed. This problem is valid to model the propagation of the electric signals in finite lossy transmission line and can be used in synthesis of the MEMS devices. The absence of small denominators due to presence of loss in the line is shown. Some simulation results are presented.

articleTitle: Modified Mathematical Model of Vibrations of a Long-Sized Plate and its Application to the Analysis of MEMS Structures
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The research and analysis of wave processes in micro- and nanoscale structures are closely related to searching for precise analytical solutions of mathematical physics problems that simulate vibrations in such type systems. Classical models of mechanics don't allow us to describe the nature of the wave process adequately. The main disadvantage of such approaches to modeling MEMS-systems is the lack of precise methods for research. In the paper, wave processes in long-scaled constructions under the action of external forces are considered as a two-point in time problem for a nonhomogeneous wave equation in an unbounded domain. There is proposed a precise method for constructing a solution in this mathematical model. The method is illustrated to describe the vibration processes of the infinite membrane. There is possible to model the behavior of the oscillations properly and also to control the parameters of such type systems due to the presented method.

articleTitle: Optimization of Parameters of Microstrip T-junction
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: A rigorous electrodynamics' description of microstrip T -junction based on the Green function method is proposed. An explicit analytical representation for the components of electric field vector is derived. The unknown coefficients in the above representation are determined by combination of both the analytical and numerical integration. The values of scattering matrix are calculated for the structure with the optimal geometric parameters.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Computer Generated Optical Element for Visual Cryptographic System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The methodology of manufacturing functional micro optical elements of sensors applied in visual cryptographic human health monitoring systems is presented. This optical element contains complex microstructure based on dynamic visual cryptography and computer generated holography. The main stages of design, manufacturing and analysis of such type functional micro optics elements are presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Applying the Moore's Law for a Long Time using Multi-Layer Crystal Square on a Chip
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Increasing the speed of a CPU and improving its performance play the main role in the design and architecture of each new generation of a microprocessor. Many factors are affected on the increasing of the CPU's speed, the main important one is the number of transistors on a chip; more transistors, more speed. Relating to Moore's law, the number of transistors should be increased twice every two years approximately. Some limitations effect on the increasing the number of transistors such as the die size, density of transistors, design complexity and others. This article introduces a new approach to delay these limitations; this allows applying the Moore's law for more years in future. The basic idea is to increase the number of transistors on a chip by manufacturing a multi-layer crystal square where the transistors can be fitted, in this case Moore's law can be applied as much as possible every 24 months by increasing the transistor count. Applying this approach needs to change the height of a chip for the two or more layers, this delays the changing in the design complexity and/or density of transistors in a crystal square and the changing in the die size.

articleTitle: On Simulation of Wave Processes in Electromechanical Systems by a Problem with Two- Point Time Conditions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Wave processes in an infinite membrane under the action of external force at given conditions of the process at two moments of time are modeled by a two-point problem for the D'Alembert equation. A class of quasi-polynomials which is a class of uniqueness solvability of problem is established. Due to the modification of the mathematical model of oscillation, it is possible to propose a differential-symbol method for construction of exact solutions of the problem. The examples of researching the wave processes in a membrane with two fixed given states are proposed. The indicated results can be effectively used in the study of the mathematical models of MEMS oscillations.

articleTitle: Application of novel image processing and analysis methods to objectivization of medical diagnosing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The paper presents two examples of imaging techniques usage in medical diagnostics. The first solution is a system supporting diagnostics of the knee joints osteoarthritis. On the basis of a series of images obtained by means of the MRI examination, geometrical parameters of the selected areas subjected to diagnostics are determined in the form of a series of 2D sections and a reconstructed 3D solid. On the basis of determined parameters, the areas are classified as healthy or potentially degenerate. The second solution supports the assessment of wound healing progress and is particularly useful when standard measurement methods are difficult to use. The method combines thermovision and 3D scanning techniques. Proposed procedures can be evaluated with the application of the registered thermovision image or by mapping the temperature distribution directly on the 3D model. The paper concerns implementation of discussed methods and presents examples of system operation.

articleTitle: Multicomponent Model of the Heart Rate Variability Change-point
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The multicomponent model of the heart rate change-point taking into account its complex structure and reflecting the dynamics of the statistical characteristics changes in time is constructed. Such a model distinguishes a set of piecewise-stationary and piecewise-periodic random processes in the general class of non-stationary random processes with their characteristics change-point. This makes it possible to apply well-known methods of random signals processing to such nonstationary rhythmic cardiac signals.

articleTitle: Sensory Measurements, Efficient Encoding and Frame Structure Improving for Data Exchange
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The analysis of sensory codes that are recorded on the outputs of the ADC are carried out in this article. The characteristics of redundancy of measuring data encoding in the ranges of digital values 0÷2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sup>(k=7,8,10,12) are investigated. It is shown that such encoding of sensory measurements has redundancy. This redundancy arises from the fact that the standards for the accuracy classes of the sensors are given at the boundary of decimal arithmetic (100, 200, 1000, 4000, etc.), and the source codes of the microcontrollers ADCs are in the corresponding boundaries of the binary number system (128, 256, 1024, 4096 ...). That is, the digital codes on the outputs of the ADC in the ranges (101÷107, 201÷255, 1001÷1023, 4001÷4095) are redundant and do not have an information load in the data exchange protocols by distributive information and measuring systems. The information technology of efficient use of such redundant codes is proposed as service and register data, which is simplifying solution to the problem of improving the frames structures of data exchange frames.

articleTitle: 79 Mathematical Model of Adapted Ultrasonic Bonding Process for MEMS Packaging
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In the paper, approach to adaptation ultrasonic bonding process for MEMS WLP is proposed. The results of the welded joint of dissimilar plates simulation are presented. Based on them, dependency between quality of the welded joint and the technological parameter of the welding speed is given. Mathematical Model of Adapted Ultrasonic Bonding Process for MEMS Packaging is developed.

articleTitle: Hardware Implementation Design of Parallelized Fuzzy Adaptive Resonance Theory Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: A hardware implementation design of parallelized fuzzy Adaptive Resonance Theory neural network is described and simulated. Parallel category choice and resonance are implemented in the network. Continuous-time and discrete-time winner-take-all neural circuits identifying the largest of M inputs are used as the winner-take-all units. The continuous-time circuit is described by a state equation with a discontinuous right-hand side. The discrete-time counterpart is governed by a difference equation. Corresponding functional block-diagrams of the circuits include M feed-forward hard-limiting neurons and one feedback neuron, which is used to compute the dynamic shift of inputs. The circuits combine arbitrary finite resolution of inputs, high convergence speed to the winner-take-all operation, low computational and hardware implementation complexity, and independence of initial conditions. The circuits are also used for finding elements of input vector with minimal/maximal values to normalize them in the range [0, 1].

Author Keywords: state equation with a discontinuous right-hand side

articleTitle: Method for Selecting Windows for PSD Analysis of MEMS Inertial Sensors' Signals
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Any measurements of inertial sensors contain noise whose color should be properly determined, otherwise a sensor would be inapplicable. The most popular tools used for determination of the noise color are Allan variance and power spectral density (PSD) calculation. The latter provides quite inaccurate results if an improper window function is applied to the input signal. Numerous window functions are covered in the literature, however, there are discrepancies in opinions on which of them is the best, and there is no clear instruction how to choose a proper window. We have conducted numerical experiments over a set of simulated signals and found out that different window functions become the best choice depending on conditions. We have developed a method of testing a window function on a set of deterministic signals, noise and some mix of deterministic signals and noise, given some known sample frequency, sample length and window length. Upon the method a new software tool has been developed. The tool allows the users to perform multiple numerical experiments and, having collected statistical data, predict the best window suitable under specific conditions.

articleTitle: Computer Processing of Ambulatory Blood Pressure Monitoring as Multivariate Data
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE XVth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The blood pressure (systolic and diastolic) and heart rate of a patient were tested hourly during about 24-hours. Such a test is well-known in many clinics as ambulatory blood pressure monitoring. It is a standard for hypertension diagnostics. Usually, these three data sets are considering separately as different time series. Each series delivers its own information. We propose another approach, considering each measuring as a three-dimensional vector of the patient state at the given moment. Indeed, this vector is an image, that is a moment describing of patient's state. Thereby, the entire test might show us the dynamic of the state in the phase space during the observation period. The idea is borrowed from the pattern recognition and perhaps will sound well for the processing and visualization of monitoring results. According to the presented findings, the model of information system based on Micro-Electro-Mechanical System (MEMS) sensor for data collection and processing. The mathematical apparatus for the system has been adopted to the requirements for devices with low computational power. Thus, it can be implemented using modern microcontrollers.

abstract: The following topics are dealt with: micromechanical devices; microsensors; medical signal processing; plates (structures); logic design; mobile robots; SLAM (robots); damping; cardiology; statistical analysis.
